message.content:
Emerald green sheath dress, A-line silhouette hitting just above the knee, #0f5132 color, heavy velvet fabric with a subtle tonal damask pattern.
Charcoal gray wide-leg trousers, tailored high-waisted cut falling straight to the ankle, #36454F color, fine merino wool blend.
Navy blue structured blazer, cropped length ending at the waist, #1B263B color, textured bouclé fabric.
Silver pointed-toe pumps, medium heel height, #C0C0C0 metallic finish, satin material with a thin ankle strap.
Pearl drop earrings, round freshwater pearls measuring 8mm, #FFFFF0 luster, set in white gold.
A warm cashmere wrap scarf, infinity loop style, #FFF8DC soft cream color, brushed wool blend for warmth against the frost.

This outfit balances the "smart" and "formal" dress codes required for an upscale New Year's restaurant celebration by pairing a luxurious velvet sheath with a tailored blazer and wide-leg trousers. The deep emerald green of the dress complements her warm skin tones while adding festive elegance suitable for autumn weather, ensuring she stays stylish yet comfortable against the frost. Silver accessories and metallic pumps provide a cool-toned contrast that elevates the look without clashing with the rich jewel tone of the main garment. Finally, the cashmere wrap offers essential warmth for the chilly evening while maintaining an effortless, chic aesthetic appropriate for the occasion.
